snippet.title: Slop Simulator - Game Trailer
snippet.description:
Put on your apron and scavenge for scraps, trash and other backstreet delicacies to mix together into delicious fast food slop!
Slop Simulator is a chaotic, silly, and gross fast food simulator for you and any number of friends!

Register for the playtest on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4199050/Slop_Simulator/
